name: query_uniprot
description: Query UniProt protein database for protein information, sequences, and functional annotations
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_uniprot; result = query_uniprot('BRCA1')

parameters.gene_or_protein: str — gene symbol or protein name (e.g. 'BRCA1', 'TP53')
parameters.fields: list — UniProt fields to retrieve (default: standard protein fields)

returns: dict with keys: proteins (list of {uniprot_id, gene, protein_name, organism, sequence_length, function}), source
